description: This file contains extension methods for the CronJobEditor class in SwiftUI, providing UI helpers and logic for managing cron job configurations, including hydration from existing jobs, validation, payload construction, and schedule management.

methods.name: gridLabel
methods.description: Creates a styled label view with secondary foreground style and specific width, used for UI layout in cron job editor.

methods.name: hydrateFromJob
methods.description: Populates the editor's state from an existing job object, setting various fields based on job properties.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Attempts to build the payload from current editor state and calls the save callback; sets error if validation or building fails.

methods.name: buildPayload
methods.description: Constructs a dictionary representing the cron job payload based on current form data, including validation.

methods.name: buildDelivery
methods.description: Builds delivery mode configuration for the cron job based on current UI selections and data.

methods.name: trimmed
methods.description: Utility to trim whitespace and newlines from a string.

methods.name: requireName
methods.description: Validates the name field is non-empty, throwing an error if invalid.

methods.name: buildSchedule
methods.description: Constructs schedule configuration based on selected schedule type (at, every, or cron).

methods.name: buildSelectedPayload
methods.description: Creates the payload section of the configuration depending on payload type.

methods.name: validateSessionTarget
methods.description: Ensures session target settings are compatible with payload type.

methods.name: validatePayloadRequiredFields
methods.description: Checks if required fields for payload are filled.

methods.name: applyDeleteAfterRun
methods.description: Sets deleteAfterRun flag in the root dictionary based on schedule and user options.

methods.name: buildAgentTurnPayload
methods.description: Constructs payload for agent turn message including optional fields.

methods.name: parseDurationMs
methods.description: Parses duration string with units into milliseconds, supporting formats like '10m', '1h', '2d'.

methods.name: effectiveSessionTargetRaw
methods.description: Determines the raw session target string considering preserved state.

methods.name: isIsolatedLikeSessionTarget
methods.description: Checks if the session target is not 'main', indicating an isolated-like target.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats duration in milliseconds into a concise human-readable string.
